title: C-17 drops off a mystery box at a guarded North Dakota hangar
summary: Dylan Borland tells of C-17 drops off a mystery box at a guarded North Dakota hangar, about c. 2012 or earlier at North Dakota, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and he was talking about a situation in North Dakota where a C17 landed, they dropped off a box. It was this whole ordeal in the middle of the night.

plain: Dylan Borland, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, passes on what a security forces member, known only by the nickname Raven, told him. According to that account, in North Dakota around 2012 or earlier, a C-17, a large military cargo plane, landed in the middle of the night and dropped off a box at a heavily guarded hangar, and the whole thing was a big ordeal. It is told as a hint that the military was moving something secret, possibly recovered from a crash.
